The '''Morellia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Morellian Commonwealth/Legends|Morellian Commonwealth]] within [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Morellia/Legends|Morellia]].
